name: Crossroads: the Weapon Crate no longer stands inside Thork (#10879)
contract: #10879 reported the Weapon Crate (gameobject guid 13310, entry 3661) at Thork's feet with Thork partly inside it. #7212 had moved Thork (creature guid 14344) to his QuestSuperTrack point (-481.527, -2594.870, 103.450), 0.6 yd from the crate, which kept its stock position (-481.966, -2595.26, 103.638). The crate now stands on Thork's former spot (-473.202, -2595.7, 103.806) on the same tower floor, at least 3 yd from Thork, on the ground and clear of walls. Thork keeps his QuestSuperTrack point.
